'''January 2001 Phoenix tournament (26 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Outer Rim, Phoenix, Arizona on 26 January 2001. [[Chris Deese]] won it. It is known from Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1671">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-27-viper-turnss-dark-side-phoenix-az-1-26d1671/ viper-turnss-dark-side-phoenix-az-1-26], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 27 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-27-viper-turnss-dark-side-phoenix-az-1-26d1671/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 January 2001
* '''Site:''' The Outer Rim, Phoenix, Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Deese]]
